meaning:
§ Zereda or Zeredathah = "fortress"
a town or territory in Manasseh and the home of Jeroboam

elsewhere.note: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
